settings.heading: Comfort is
settings.text: Elitlux is a UK bedding brand founded on a simple belief: everyone deserves to sleep the way they do in a good hotel — without paying hotel prices for it. We design duvets, pillows, protectors, toppers and cushions that bring that feeling home.

settings.image_1_alt: Woman reading in bed, supported by a U-shape pillow
settings.image_2_alt: Unmade white bed in soft morning light
settings.image_3_alt: Woman asleep on a V-shape pillow in a sage bedroom

settings.title: Considered comfort
settings.text: Every product starts with how it feels: plump fills, smooth covers and quilting that keeps its shape.

settings.title: Honest quality
settings.text: We tell you exactly what’s in it — the fill, the fabric, the size — and never promise more than a pillow can do.

settings.title: Care in the detail
settings.text: Machine-washable fills and covers, so keeping your bed fresh is easy.

settings.title: Restorative calm
settings.text: Hotel-quality comfort for every home, without the big spend.

settings.title: Refreshing a tired bed
settings.text: A Mattress Topper adds 10cm of even softness — no new mattress needed.

settings.title: Back, neck, bump or nursing
settings.text: U and V-shape pillows that hold you, from bump to baby.

settings.title: Sleeping with allergies
settings.text: Hypoallergenic fills and 100% waterproof protectors, with every material stated plainly.
